description.text: The fourth Sword & Shield set, released on 13 November 2020 with 203 cards: 185 and 18 secret rares. It brought Amazing Pokémon outside Japan, six Legendary and Mythical Pokémon with rainbow-splashed art and special effects, and centers on Gigantamax Pikachu, as Pikachu VMAX. It also has Zarude V, a newly discovered Mythical Pokémon. Its theme decks are led by Charizard and Drednaw.
